column1: # The message map for debug-log output: one row per message, which gives the
# message its number in its component. Rows are append-only. Never edit,
# delete, or reorder one, so that each number keeps its meaning for every
# decoder. `cargo xtask build` in fw/plat/uno appends the rows for new
# messages, and `cargo xtask log-map` also updates log_messages.h. Commit both
# with the code that adds the messages.
